old_row.relationship: Livestock offered as whole burnt offerings
old_row.rationale: The psalm names oxen and other flock animals among its whole burnt offerings. Leviticus explicitly authorizes gifts from cattle and the flock and describes a cattle whole burnt offering. This supplies the ritual setting without claiming the law uses the psalm's marrow-rich description.

new_row.relationship: Livestock offered as whole burnt offerings
new_row.rationale: The psalm names whole burnt offerings alongside rams, oxen and he-goats. Leviticus authorizes gifts from cattle and the flock and specifically describes a cattle whole burnt offering. This supplies a ritual comparison without assigning every animal in the psalm to that offering class or adding its marrow-rich description to the law.
